items.title: Helen Oakley Dance interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 12, 1998
items.q: And there was Fletcher’s band, and where was Hawk? He’d just gone to England.

ctx.x: And when was the first time you got to see and hear jazz — to see something live?

You must stop me you know, if you want me to move from period to period — but because I would not do the things — my sister and I were close in age and we were debutantes in Toronto and that was Toronto for you. And she went on from there and had quite a wonderful career. And I said no, I’m going to the States. And my family didn’t think much of that. And so my mother said, “All right, I’ll take you to Detroit, and I’ll see that you’re set up properly, have a piano and somebody to watch over you” and so on. So I…
